changes: Suggested experiment grids now show italic fitted ICxx labels beside concentration headers and display one organism–drug layout at a time with previous/next controls.
Click the version number in the header to view changes in each recorded version.
Dose Anchors now shows Closest Anchor, Maximum Dose Retention, and editable Assigned Dose Anchor columns, with buttons to copy either suggested set.
Check how many combination doses the assigned anchors retain before analysis, and see compatible anchors when too few doses remain.
Plan repeat experiments with concentration grids, single-agent rows and columns, rounded maximum concentrations, and exact twofold dilutions.
Repeat-layout anchors follow the rounded concentration ratio; extrapolated IC50 estimates are flagged as provisional.
Added Drusano–Greco fitting, count-data sampling, regimen simulation, and comparison.
Added MuSyC analysis and project save/load.
Added native DiaMOND analysis, dose-response plots, and regimen comparison.
Expanded native Bliss calculations and SynergyFinder compatibility checks.
Improved regimen comparison, bootstrap results, and workbook export.
Introduced the self-contained Tauri desktop app with React and native Rust assay analysis.
